newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian says 1996 net grain output 68.4 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Russian says 1996 net grain output 68.4 mln tonnes.

text.p: Russian Agriculture Minister Viktor Khlystun told a news conference on Tuesday that Russia's 1996 net grain output was 68.4 million tonnes, below government expectations of around 70 million tonnes.

"Because of the weather, in Siberia alone we lost seven million tonnes of grain during the harvest," he said. He added that Russia's 1996 output was five million tonnes above last year's 63.4 million tonnes, which was Russia's worst harvest in three decades.
He said that during the 50-day harvest in Western and Eastern Siberia, only six days did not have rain or snow.
The State Statistics Committee last month put gross grain output at 74.6 million tonnes, later revised to 74.8 million.
Russian officials, including Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Zaveryukha, in charge of the harvest, said farmers had under-reported output by at least several million tonnes.
